action.objective: Verify Kf2 as the commit move, confirming the king stays safe from Black's rook checks and that White keeps the extra material.
action.rationale: Broad depth-4 search over both legal moves gave Kf2 exact +715 and Ke2 upper-bounded +715, so Ke2 could be worse. Kf2 also keeps the king off the c-file/2nd rank line where Black's rook on c1 gives checks. Verify Kf2 at full depth to close the gate before committing.
